title_en: 1+1 for sale in the Magnet Complex, December 21.
description_en: Description 🏡 1+1 apartment for sale - 61 m² 📍 First floor The apartment is organized in: ✔️ Living room + open space kitchen ✔️ 1 bedroom ✔️ Toilet ✔️ Natural lighting throughout the day as there are three windows in each room. The environment is functional and suitable for both residence and investment, or for office as it has an easy exit from the building and is accessible on both sides of the complex. It is located on the first floor, with good visibility and practical organization of the space.
